subtext.$description: A line of text and the smaller line under it that describes it. Examples: User Name → Admin, an input → its helper line. (Page title → Version row has no gap; PageHeading owns it.)

icon-label.$description: An icon or checkbox → its text label. Examples: nav icon → label, search icon → placeholder, upload icon → text, checkbox → Prod.

attached.$description: Other parts of one element. Examples: logo → its name, breadcrumb items, version badge → published text, tab label → count badge, table → its scrollbar.

choices.$description: Between big clickable boxes in a set. Examples: nav items, Prod ↔ Pre-Prod option boxes. Not for tabs (use spacing/group).

related.$description: A pair that does one job, items in a list, or a heading and the list it names. Examples: label → input, cards in a list, All Apps → its list, back icon → page title, two buttons side by side. Not for tabs → their content (use spacing/group).

group.$description: Different groups in the same area, stacked or side by side. Examples: field → field, Select Page ↔ Select Module, filter ↔ filter, tab ↔ tab, tabs → table, logo → language picker → app list, page title ↔ action buttons (minimum).

region.$description: Between the main blocks of a modal or card: header, filters, content, footer.

section.$description: Different sections of a page. Example: Hero → Projects → About → Contact.

page.$description: All sides of the page frame; left/right of the header so it lines up with the page.

panel.$description: All sides of a modal; top/bottom of a card.

container-x.$description: Left/right inside boxes that hold other things, like the sidebar.

container-y.$description: Top/bottom inside boxes that hold other things, like the sidebar.

control-x.$description: Left/right inside nav items; also the logo row and headings like All Apps, so they line up with the nav icons.

control-y.$description: Top/bottom inside nav items and text areas.

field-x.$description: Left/right inside inputs, dropdowns, text areas and table cells (header and body).

gap.$description: Exception. Avatar → name → chevron in the profile menu.

inset.$description: Exception. All sides inside the profile menu button.

inset-x.$description: Exception. Left/right inside the Prod and Pre-Prod option boxes.

inset-y.$description: Exception. Top/bottom inside the Prod and Pre-Prod option boxes.

inset-x.$description: Exception. Left/right inside the page card.

inset-y.$description: Exception. Top/bottom of the modal's footer wrapper. Intentional, keep it.
